full_prompt_en: A square, intricately layered storybook illustration shows a young person's pale face in right-facing profile beneath an ornate cream-and-gold hood. The background is a deep muted blue filled with fine golden botanical lines and thin arching borders. Behind the head at the upper left, a dense cluster of amber flowers grows among dark branches, turning the left half into a warm, textured canopy. Small pale birds overlap this cluster: one crosses the left side with wings spread, while another perches near the upper right edge of the hood. The face occupies the center-right, its blue eye looking toward the right edge. Soft rose color warms the cheek and lips, and the skin is modeled gently against the more elaborate surroundings. The cream hood curves from forehead to the back of the head and carries delicate gold circular motifs and narrow patterned trim. A thin cord descends along the cheek. Beneath it, a dark blue ribbed high collar surrounds the neck, and a broad ochre outer garment folds across the lower left. In the middle distance, slender cream towers and small building roofs rise at both sides of the face. The tallest pointed tower stands beyond the nose on the right, partly framed by the blue decorative field. Tiny branches, flowers, and geometric tracery continue into the corners, making the background feel like an illuminated page rather than an empty landscape. The palette is tightly organized around blue, ochre, gold, cream, and restrained pink. Fine line work defines petals, architectural edges, border arcs, and fabric pattern, while the face remains smoother and quieter. Diffuse warm light falls on the face and pale hood from the upper left, leaving the blue background deeper and the golden foliage gently luminous. There is no clearly readable text. The overall composition sets a still, sharply profiled face between intricate floral and architectural rhythms, balancing delicate narrative detail with a calm central expression.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、层次繁密的故事书插画：一个年轻人的浅色面庞朝右侧面呈现，头上罩着奶油金色的华丽兜帽。背景是深而低调的蓝色，布满细密金色植物线条和纤细弧形边框。头后左上方，一簇浓密的琥珀色花朵长在深色枝条间，使左半幅成为温暖而有肌理的树冠。浅色小鸟与花丛交叠：一只在左侧张翼飞过，另一只栖在兜帽右上缘附近。面庞占据中央偏右，蓝色眼睛望向右边缘。柔和玫瑰色温暖了面颊和嘴唇，皮肤在更繁复的环境前得到轻柔塑形。奶油色兜帽从额头弯向后脑，带有精细的金色圆形纹样和窄窄的花纹边饰。一条细系带沿面颊垂下。兜帽之下，深蓝色罗纹高领环绕脖颈，宽阔的赭黄外衣在左下方形成褶叠。中景里，纤细奶油色塔楼和小屋顶从脸的两侧升起。最高的尖塔位于右侧鼻尖之外，部分被蓝色装饰背景框住。细小枝条、花朵和几何线纹持续伸向角落，让背景像一页彩绘书页，而不是空白风景。配色严格围绕蓝、赭黄、金、奶油色和克制的粉色组织。细线描出花瓣、建筑边缘、边框弧线和衣料花纹，脸部则保持更平滑、更安静。柔和暖光从左上落在脸和浅色兜帽上，让蓝背景更深，金色花叶轻轻发亮。画中没有清晰可读文字。整体构图把静止、轮廓鲜明的侧脸安置在繁密花卉与建筑节奏之间，使精巧叙事细节与平静的中心神情取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Ornate storybook illustration layers fine linear pattern over a deep cool ground, then introduces dense warm clusters as a counterweight. Small curves, arches, circular motifs, and branching marks repeat at several scales, producing a decorative rhythm without obscuring the smoother central form. Gold, ochre, and cream accents glow against muted blue, while restrained pink softens the highest-contrast focal area. Foreground edges are carefully drawn; more distant detail becomes smaller and flatter, creating shallow but readable depth. Diffuse warm light lifts pale areas rather than casting sharp shadows. The surface feels matte and finely worked, with tactile line density more important than glossy effects. The overall impression is elaborate yet composed, with richly patterned margins enclosing a calm focus.
style_prompt_zh: 华丽的故事书插画在深冷色底上叠加纤细线纹，再用密集的暖色群组形成平衡。小曲线、拱形、圆形纹样和分枝笔迹以不同尺度反复出现，形成装饰节奏，却不遮蔽较平滑的中央形体。金、赭黄和奶油色重点在低调蓝色前发亮，克制的粉色柔化反差最强的焦点区域。前景边缘精细勾绘；较远细节变小、变平，形成浅而清晰的纵深。柔和暖光提亮浅色区域，而非投下尖锐阴影。表面哑光且精工细作，线条密度带来的可感质地比光亮效果更重要。整体印象繁复而有序，丰富花纹的边缘围住平静焦点。
theme_en: A young profile in a patterned hood among golden flowers and small towers
theme_zh: 戴花纹兜帽的年轻侧脸，周围是金花与小塔楼
name: Thomas Ascott
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
